Sore back is a symptom, so that part is one for a doctor or physio, not me. If the soreness is getting worse, spreads, or comes with numbness or tingling, get it looked at before you load it.

On the training side: I can't answer "dumbbells only today" without seeing what's planned, so let me check your program for today. The program lookup came back empty, so I can't see what's on your schedule for today. Tell me what you have planned and what equipment you've got, and I'll help you decide what to do with dumbbells only. I'd also keep anything that loads the back out of today's session until a doctor or physio has cleared it.
